name: Zeltplatz Leitzachtal
beschreibung:
History

The Zeltplatz Leitzachtal lies, according to all the directories retrieved, in Weyarn in Oberbayern, district of Miesbach, and not in Tirol. A business website with a founding history was not found. Kartogiraffe names the operator Leopold Numberger, house number 22 1/3, postcode 83629, and classifies the entry as a campsite. OnlineStreet names the address Schöffleiten 22 1/3, 83629 Weyarn, the same operator and the telephone number +49 8063 423. The page wie.de, by contrast, lists Gnadenleite 22 1/3, 83629 Naring, with the coordinates 47.867729, 11.852565, as of 2 February 2026, and itself points out that the data should be checked before a visit. The street address is not uniform between Schöffleiten and Gnadenleite and is not reduced here to one variant. FreizeitMonster places the site in Weyarn, district Holzolling, and writes that only tent guests are welcome, no motorhomes and no caravans.

Getting there

A separate arrival page of the site is not available. The directories place it in the Leitzachtal near Weyarn. Which bus line stops there is not stated in the sources named. Anyone looking for the site should use the telephone number +49 8063 423 and have the street address confirmed, because the directory addresses diverge. The entry belongs geographically to Bayern. An approach to Tirol via the Inntal does not reach this site.

Tips

What is documented across several directories is the restriction to tents. Facilities such as electricity, showers or a season from April to October appear on individual portal pages that look like generated texts, and are therefore not adopted as established site rules. Prices, house rules and current opening hours should be asked directly of the operator. For a stay in Tirol this data set is the wrong place.
kurzbeschreibung: Campsite in Weyarn, district of Miesbach, Bayern, not in Tirol. Directories name tents without motorhomes and the operator Leopold Numberger.
